lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Ti2Fe4O12 (reduced formula LiTi(FeO3)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and Ti each in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li shows four O neighbors; O centers have four geometric neighbors (one Fe, one Ti, two Li). Corner-sharing is observed between Fe and Ti octahedra, as well as between Fe octahedra, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
